newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Ex-Im Bank lends 8 bln yen to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Ex-Im Bank lends 8 bln yen to Philippines.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Wednesday that it had agreed to extend an 8.0 billion yen loan to the Philippine National Bank for use by small- and medium-sized businesses in the Philippines.

The proceeds of the loan will be used to buy construction machines and medical equipment from Japanese firms, it said in a statement. These purchases are expected to help develop the country's infrastructure and improve its medical services. The projects will also raise social welfare standards in the Philippines, it added.
The Ex-Im Bank decided to provide the loan to the Philippine National Bank because it has the largest network of branch offices and the resources to review and analyse credit applications, it said.
The loan was co-financed by seven major Japanese banks, including Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi.
